## Story DD Coverage
None directly — doc-router Gate 2 (existing reference doc) gated documentation task. Operator-facing context for why fetcher prefers startAt over nextPageToken and how to interpret SilentTruncationError.

## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md references JRACLOUD-94632
  Verify: grep -F 'JRACLOUD-94632' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md documents the 1000-result hard ceiling
  Verify: grep -E '1000-result|1000 issue|hard ceiling' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md mentions SilentTruncationError
  Verify: grep -F 'SilentTruncationError' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## Implementation Notes
Append a section to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md covering:
1. JRACLOUD-94632 — why nextPageToken is avoided in favor of startAt
2. The 1000-result hard ceiling and what SilentTruncationError means operationally
3. First-checks when a fetcher pass aborts with SilentTruncationError (JQL scope, alert_store contents)

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference doc); CLAUDE.md is NOT a target.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
